name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A text input that filters a list of options as the user types, ignoring case and accents: the WAI-ARIA combobox with arrow keys, Home, End, Enter and Escape, that submits its value with a form; its list is never taller than the room it has. Labelled, described and marked invalid by its Field.
docs: The animations use the animate-in and animate-out classes of tw-animate-css, which `shadcn init` installs and imports in your CSS.
